title: MP-Camera Settings Schema
description: Configuration schema for MP-Camera application. Settings are grouped by area: camera, streaming, measurement, inference, models, services, paths, ui, and upload.

fourcc.description: Video codec FOURCC string used by OpenCV (e.g. MJPG, mp4v).

force_directshow.description: On Windows, force OpenCV to use DirectShow (CAP_DSHOW).

selected_camera_index.description: Default camera device index or -1 for none.

frame_interval_ms.description: Frame timer interval in milliseconds (controls target FPS).

inference_interval_ms.description: Interval between automatic stream inferences in milliseconds.

measurement.description: Physical measurement parameters used to compute μm/pixel and morphometrics.

effective_sensor_width_mm.description: Active sensor width in millimeters (used by um-per-pixel calculation).

effective_sensor_height_mm.description: Active sensor height in millimeters (used by um-per-pixel calculation).

default_magnification.description: Default total magnification used to seed magnification controls.

default_confidence.description: Default confidence threshold exposed on the camera page slider.

default_iou.description: Default IoU (NMS) threshold exposed on the camera page slider.

local_confidence_threshold.description: Default confidence used by local models (LocalModelInference).

local_iou_threshold.description: Default IoU used by local models (LocalModelInference).

device_preference.description: Device selection for local model inference (auto chooses CUDA if available).

workflow_id.description: Roboflow workflow id for cloud inference or identifier for cloud model.

prefer_local.description: If true, prefer local .pth models when available.

local_models_dir.description: Directory scanned for local `.pth` models (relative to project root or absolute).

api_url.description: Roboflow inference HTTP API base URL.

api_key.description: Roboflow API key (sensitive). Applications should treat as secret).

timeout_seconds.description: HTTP request timeout for Directus operations in seconds.

models_dir.description: Path used by CLI/test utilities to look for local models.

validation_images_dir.description: Default path for validation images used by `run_validation_inference.py`.

temp_image_suffix.description: Suffix used when writing temporary adjusted images.

fixed_window_size.description: If true, the main window is forced to a fixed size.

show_overlays_by_default.description: If true, inference overlays are visible by default when camera/image loads.

update_aggregates.description: When true, update soil/site aggregate counters (fiber_count, fragment_count, ...) after uploads.

auto_upload.description: If true, automatically upload detected items to Directus when saving results.
